create.name: Gillian White
create.bio:
Gillian White is a spiritual teacher, priestess and ceremonialist based in the foothills south of Calgary, Alberta. Her path draws on more than two decades of study. She trained with Denise Linn in Soul Coaching®, reaching master practitioner level, and is one of a small number of people Linn has chosen to train and certify new Soul Coaches. Alongside that she has qualified in Feng Shui, space clearing, Reiki, dowsing, past-life coaching and herbalism. More recently she became a life celebrant, and she is studying with OneSpirit towards ordination as an interfaith minister.

Much of her teaching grows out of folk witchcraft, the Celtic wheel of the year and the sacred feminine. She hosts seasonal women's circles and a monthly coven in the yurt beside her home, with an online coven on Zoom following the same themes, and a monthly gathering she calls the Yurch, where the group has been reading the Gospel of Mary Magdalene and other overlooked stories of women in faith. She also leads small-group pilgrimages to Ireland and Scotland, offers ritual healing sessions and Feng Shui consultations, and records the Weaving Soul Magick podcast. On Insight Timer she shares guided journeys and meditations on nature, the moon and the faerie realm.

courses.title: Wyld Sister Coven (online)
courses.description: A monthly live Zoom gathering for women that takes one theme of everyday magick at a time, with a simple ritual, prompts for keeping a Book of Shadows and group sharing. Gatherings are recorded, and past months can be bought as recordings with handouts. An in-person circle meets in her yurt on the same themes.

courses.title: Seasonal Wyld Sister Circles
courses.description: Women's circles held in Gillian's yurt in the Alberta foothills to mark the turning points of the year, such as the solstices. Evenings combine ritual, a bonfire when the weather allows, tea and time to talk, for up to about twenty women.

courses.title: Yurch
courses.description: A monthly in-person gathering in Gillian's yurt, usually near the first Sunday, that explores the Divine Feminine through story, reading, ritual and shared questions. Recent series have worked through the Gospel of Mary Magdalene. There is no set fee.

courses.title: Sacred Caim Healing
courses.description: A two-hour one-to-one session that opens with conversation and a cup of tea, then moves into a ritual circle and hands-on energy work using sound, crystals, scent and pendulum. It closes with oracle cards and simple practices to take home.

courses.title: Magickal Home for the Soul
courses.description: A one-to-one programme that brings together Feng Shui, Soul Coaching® and folk magick for your home. It includes a first consultation, a written report sent by post, a follow-up session and three months of email support.

courses.title: Feng Shui Magick
courses.description: A self-paced six-week online course on working with your home's energy yourself. It covers the Bagua map, the five elements and clearing clutter, with practices for setting intentions through your space.

courses.title: Wyld Sister Journey to Scotland 2027
courses.description: An eight-day women's pilgrimage from Edinburgh through the Highlands to Orkney, Skye and Oban, visiting stone circles and places tied to Scottish myth, with circle and ceremony along the way. Pricing and the full itinerary are still being finalised, and a waitlist is open by email.

courses.title: Celebration of Life & Funeral Services
courses.description: As a life celebrant Gillian writes and leads funerals and celebrations of life with the family, shaped around the person's own story and beliefs. Services can be religious, spiritual or wholly secular.

free_resources.title: Gillian White on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations and journeys from Gillian on the moon, ancestors, trees and the faerie realm, plus gentle relaxation and gratitude practices. Free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Hosting the Archangels
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guide to a five-day home ritual for welcoming five archangels, built around a simple altar and a candle, with a playlist to go with it. No sign-up needed.

free_resources.title: Witch Wound
free_resources.description: A free hour-long recorded class sent by email that looks at the inherited fear around women's intuition and magick, with journalling as you go.

free_resources.title: Free Weekly Soul Rituals
free_resources.description: A short ritual delivered to your inbox every Sunday evening when you join Gillian's mailing list.

free_resources.title: Weaving Soul Magick podcast
free_resources.description: Gillian's podcast of talks, stories and recordings from her yurt gatherings on witchcraft, the wheel of the year and the Divine Feminine, running since 2021.
